subject: english
edition: EPD English Pupil's Book Grade 6 (2015 syllabus, Sixth Print 2019) + NIE English Language Teachers' Guide Grade 06 (First Edition 2014, implemented from 2015)

concepts.title_en: Hello: meeting friends and introducing myself
outcomes: Greet, thank and introduce yourself with name, age, school, hobbies and family details
Use am / is / are in positive, question and negative sentences in the present tense
Pick the expression that fits a social situation (greeting, thanking, apologising)
Hear and say short and long vowel sounds in simple words
concepts.guideRef: C.L. 1.1, 1.2, 3.2, 5.2, 5.3, 6.1 (be-verbs present), 7.1, 8.1, 8.2; TG syllabus pp. xiii-xxiv, guide pp. 1-2, 14, 21

concepts.title_en: Leisure: what people are doing now
outcomes: Describe actions happening now with the present continuous tense
Describe a picture of people at play in simple sentences
Rearrange jumbled words into correct sentences
Use question words to ask about activities and use language suited to places like a sports meet or home

concepts.title_en: Where's everything? Position, directions and plurals
outcomes: Say where things are using in, on, under, between, near, in front of and behind
Ask for and follow simple directions and spoken instructions
Follow picture-based steps to make something
Form plural nouns with -s, -es, -en and vowel change

concepts.title_en: What can you see? Determiners and describing things
outcomes: Choose this, that, these, those, a, an and some correctly
Use adjectives of colour, size, quality and origin to describe objects and rooms
Compare two pictures and say what is different
Listen for specific details in a short spoken text

concepts.title_en: Aunt Minoli's kitchen: instructions, punctuation and 'and'
outcomes: Put the steps of a simple recipe in order and match them to pictures
Write short instructions for a simple process
Use capital letters, full stops and question marks correctly
Join nouns, adjectives and sentences with 'and'

concepts.title_en: What we do: daily routines and the simple present
outcomes: Talk and write about daily routines and habits using the simple present tense
Ask classmates questions with what, when, where, who, why, how and which, and report the answers
Speak briefly about a favourite sport, food or TV programme
Write simple step-by-step instructions (for example making a mask)

concepts.title_en: A fine day: weather, time words and a poem
outcomes: Name weather conditions and match them to symbols
Use on, in and at with days, months and times
Read a short story for its main idea and details
Read a short poem aloud with rhythm and say what it is about

concepts.title_en: A visit to the zoo: can, may, possession and a folk story
concepts.unit: Unit 8 - A Visit to the Zoo
outcomes: Use 'can' for ability and 'can' / 'may' to ask for permission
Show possession with my, your and 's
Read a simple folk story and identify its characters and message
Use a simple map to complete directions and sort words by vowel sound
Find opposites (antonyms) for common words

concepts.title_en: Sugar or sand: pronouns, adverbs and gender words
outcomes: Read and complete a short humorous folk tale
Replace nouns with the right subject or object pronoun
Form adverbs and use them to describe actions
Use masculine and feminine forms of nouns
Tell apart words with similar sounds (for example /p/ and /f/)

concepts.title_en: Was it yesterday? Talking about the past
outcomes: Use was / were and the simple past of regular and common irregular verbs
Tell the class what you did yesterday or last weekend
Read a passage and transfer key facts into a table
Recite a short poem and listen for specific words

concepts.title_en: Eco friends: hobbies, animals and caring for nature
outcomes: Write a short paragraph about free-time activities
Find information about an animal and write a simple description
Listen to a short news item and complete a grid
Name young ones of animals and match words with their meanings and opposites
Use simple expressions about protecting the environment
